name: Midjourney
tagline: Text-to-image generation service known for high-quality aesthetic output

pricing.notes: Official docs checked 2026-07-30; Basic is $10/month, Standard $30, Pro $60, Mega $120.

verdictSummary: You can build a wrapper around open models, but you cannot solo-recreate Midjourney's proprietary model quality, style tuning, infrastructure, and community distribution.
coreLoopDIY: Use Stable Diffusion/Flux-style local or hosted models with a prompt UI and gallery.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for the model and taste layer, not the chat box around it.

priorArt.name: ComfyUI
priorArt.desc: Open-source node-based UI for running image-generation workflows locally or on a GPU serve

notes: Must-have no: one of the clearest frontier-model moat cases.
